references.text: Describes the consecration of the waved breast and the raised thigh from the ram used in the priests' ordination, which were to belong to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual portion from the Israelites.
Earlier verses in the same chapter explaining how the waved breast and the right thigh were to be given to Aaron and his sons from the peace offerings.
Moses explains that the waved breast and the raised thigh are to be eaten in a clean place by Aaron, his sons and daughters, as their portion from the Israelites' peace offering.
Describes the wave offering given to Aaron and his sons and daughters as a perpetual right.
The meat of the waved breast and the right thigh belongs to the priest, as a perpetual covenant of salt for Aaron and his descendants.
Describes the priests' rights from the people's offerings, including the shoulder, cheeks, and stomach as their portion.
